externalAgentPolicy.description: External AI agents operate strictly as read-only auditors and advisors. They inspect exported Playbooks, Toolbox manifests, Proof Reports, and 6-Point Audit Bundles, but cannot execute direct code or parameter changes.

interviews.taskTitle: Build & Integrate the GDF 5-Step AI Delegation, Playbook, Toolbox, Proof & Audit Operating System
interviews.objective: Eliminate repeated mistakes, lost knowledge, inconsistent execution, unnecessary rework, and unverified completion claims by enforcing a closed-loop 5-step operating system (INTERVIEW -> PLAYBOOK -> TOOLBOX -> PROOF -> LOOPBACK + ON-DEMAND AUDIT) across Google AI Studio and external read-only advisor/auditor agents.
inputsAndDependencies: Existing GDF engines & services (scientificCore.ts, intelligenceAwarenessCore.ts, realDataWaterfall.ts, quantEngine.ts, scientificDiscoveryCycleService.ts).
Canonical Markdown Playbooks (/playbooks/PB-001.md .. PB-006.md) and Toolbox Store Index (/toolbox/TOOLBOX_INDEX.md).
constraintsAndRules: All external AI agents (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) are strictly read-only auditors and advisors and cannot execute direct mutations.
Dual-Layer Persistence (Option A): Markdown files on disk synced bi-directionally with TypeScript service and JSON store.
Hard Stage-Gate Enforcement & Dual-Control Promotion Gate (Option A / Rule 8): Candidate promotion checks both OOS quantitative gates and GDF OS Proof verification.
On-Demand 6-Dimension Audit & Automatic Loopback (Option B): Explicit audit endpoint that auto-increments playbook versions (v1.0 -> v1.1) when faults or unverified items are detected.
Live Backend Proof Runner + Non-Intrusive Top Header Drawer in index.html (Option A2): Zero clutter on the primary gold forecast canvas.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 baseline Playbooks (PB-001..PB-006) exist on disk and match the required 9-field SOP template.
Centralized Toolbox Store Index (/toolbox/TOOLBOX_INDEX.md) indexes all core GDF assets with verified disk existence.
Express endpoints (/api/gdf-os/state, /interview, /playbooks, /toolbox, /run-proof, /audit, /auditor-packet) respond with verified JSON.
Live Proof Runner executes programmatic checks across Scientific Core, Awareness Core, Waterfall Provenance, News Context, and Parallel Universe Isolation, marking each PASS/FAIL/NOT VERIFIED.
Header Drawer in index.html provides 5 operator tabs without obstructing the main chart.

turns.questionText: How should Playbooks and the Toolbox Store be persisted and shared across Google AI Studio and external AI agents?
turns.operatorAnswer: All 3 options combined; external agents are strictly for external audit and advisory purposes and cannot execute any change.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Dual-Layer Persistence (Markdown files on disk + TypeScript API/JSON store + Read-Only External Auditor Packet export).

turns.questionText: How strictly should stage gates and the promotion gate (Rule 8) be enforced?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option 3 / 3a — Hard Stage-Gate Enforcement + Dual-Control Promotion Gate for both internal and external audits.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Automated candidate promotion requires both quantitative OOS gate pass and a verified PASS Proof Report.

turns.questionText: How should Audit Mode and Step 5 Loopback operate?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option B — On-Demand Audit Center with Automatic Loopback version upgrades.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Triggered on demand via /api/gdf-os/audit; automatically increments playbook versions (v1.0 -> v1.1) when faults or unverified claims are found.

turns.questionText: What baseline scope of Playbooks and Toolbox assets should be seeded initially?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option B — Full GDF Baseline Seeding (PB-001 through PB-006 + complete Toolbox Store index).
turns.resolvedConstraint: Seed PB-001..PB-006 and TB-001..TB-012 covering the entire GDF architecture.

turns.questionText: How should Proof verification be executed and exposed in the Operator MMI?
turns.operatorAnswer: Option A2 — Live Backend Proof Runner + Non-Intrusive Header Drawer in index.html.
turns.resolvedConstraint: Live backend proof execution (/api/gdf-os/run-proof) paired with a slide-over header drawer in index.html.

interviews.summaryOfUnderstanding: Implement the closed-loop 5-step GDF AI Delegation & Operating System with Dual-Layer Markdown + JSON persistence, read-only External Auditor exports, Dual-Control Promotion Gate (Rule 8), full PB-001..PB-006 and TB-001..TB-012 baseline seeding, Live Proof Runner, On-Demand 6-Point Audit + Auto-Loopback, and a non-intrusive 5-tab Header Drawer in index.html.

playbooks.playbookName: Scientific Core — 6D Latent Filter, Information Clock & Post-Shock Reset
playbooks.trigger: Triggered whenever src/engine/scientificCore.ts or src/engine/quantEngine.ts updates the 6D latent state vector [x0..x5], advances the volume-synchronized information clock, propagates the 24-step Yellow Line conditional expectation plume, or responds to a standardized innovation residual shock |z_t|.
inputs: Verified OHLCV candle array from realDataWaterfall.ts (PAXG_SPOT_TOKEN primary camera).
Secondary benchmark basis observation (COMEX_GOLD_FUTURES / GC=F when available; never identity-merged).
Verified macro factor inputs (tipsRealYield10Y, nominal10Y, dxyIndex, breakevenInflation10Y) or MACRO_FEED_UNAVAILABLE.
Active MarketAwarenessState policies (driftPolicy, anchorPolicy, bandPolicy) and Level-5 Bayesian Meta-Learning posteriors.
steps: Verify Instrument & Feed Integrity: Confirm incoming candle series has isSynthetic === false and verified provenance. Freeze P_t, tau_t, and GARCH variance under HALTED_DEGRADED.
Compute Volume-Synchronized Information Clock (delta_tau_t): Scale latent state progression by realized volume activity.
Evaluate Prior Prediction & Standardized Residual (z_t): Compute innovation e_t and standardized residual z_t; append to persistent OOS residual log.

Apply Post-Shock Reset & Drift Damping (Decision Rule 5): When |z_t| > 2.2 or BOCPD hazard spikes, decay/reset pre-shock drift velocity x_1, relax equilibrium anchor pull so it cannot manufacture fake V-shape recovery, and widen uncertainty bands.
Execute Multi-Venue Observation Update & Plume Propagation: Update 6D state and covariance P_t via Joseph-stabilized gain and propagate 24-step Yellow Line plume.
outputs: ScientificCoreTelemetry (6D latent state [x0..x5], innovation residual z_t, pulse-echo sonar events, 24-step Yellow Line plume).
ScientificScoreboard with sample-gated status (CALIBRATING when N < 30 verified OOS bars vs VERIFIED_EDGE).
proofRequired: Automated verification via scripts/check-scientific-core.ts confirming post-shock drift velocity x_1 decays/resets after >2.5 sigma displacement.
Equilibrium anchor does not rubber-band post-shock plume back to pre-crash level without market evidence.
Scoreboard reports CALIBRATING when OOS sample count is below threshold.
commonFailureModes: Pre-Shock Drift Survival (Rule 5 Violation): Leaving pre-crash bullish drift alive after a liquidation bar. Recovery: Engage SHOCK_DRIFT_RESET and scale gamma_t -> [0.05, 0.25].
Equilibrium Anchor Rubber-Banding: Stale VWAP/POC anchor forcing immediate mean-reversion against structural breakout. Recovery: Re-anchor toward post-shock spot.
Fake Certainty on Small Samples (Rule 1 Violation): Overclaiming skill on tiny OOS sample. Recovery: Force CALIBRATING state until sample gate passes.
playbooks.nextImprovement: Couple BOCPD run-length hazard h_t directly with multi-timeframe (15m/1h/4h) cross-scale innovation coherence.

playbooks.playbookName: Market Awareness & Risk — Fault Taxonomy, Session/Weekend Damping & Candidate Obligations
playbooks.trigger: Triggered on every evaluation of evaluateParallelUniverseAndAwarenessCore in src/services/intelligenceAwarenessCore.ts, during session transitions (Asia/London/NY/Weekend), after large residuals, or when news tags conflict with realized price action.
inputs: Realized price action, ATR, and standardized innovation residuals z_t from scientificCore.ts.
Session & calendar state from src/services/sessionCalendar.ts (UTC timestamp, COMEX open/closed status, weekend thin-liquidity flags).
Verified news events and category tags from realDataWaterfall.ts (monetary, inflation, yields, central_bank, geopolitics).
Level-5 Tri-Modal Causal & Symbolic Discovery state (Granger + PC causal skeleton, symbolic DAG, SINDy sparse coefficients, Episodic Shock Bank).
steps: Run FaultClassifier: Inspect forecast trajectories vs realized candles for WRONG_DIRECTION, OVERCONFIDENT_TREND, SESSION_REGIME_VIOLATION, and EQUILIBRIUM_ANCHOR_MISMATCH.

Enforce Session & Weekend Liquidity Rules (Decision Rule 6): Flag SESSION_REGIME_VIOLATION if weekday trend extrapolation runs during weekend/closed-futures regimes; compress drift slope and widen bands.
Evaluate News Transmission Mismatch (Decision Rule 7): Compare news category tags vs realized price/residual; flag NEWS_TRANSMISSION_MISMATCH when geopolitics coincides with gold liquidation.
Enforce Candidate Diversity Obligation After Faults (Decision Rule 5): Require the Parallel Universe candidate (Magenta Line) to synthesize a structurally distinct trajectory after shocks.
Emit MarketAwarenessState Policies: Output explicit driftPolicy, anchorPolicy, and bandPolicy multipliers.
outputs: MarketAwarenessState with fault taxonomy flags, session/calendar regime telemetry, news transmission diagnosis, Level-5 Bayesian regime posteriors, and candidate obligations.
proofRequired: Automated verification via scripts/check-awareness-core-upgrade.ts confirming fault taxonomy, weekend damping (Rule 6), geopolitics mismatch (Rule 7), and candidate diversity after shocks (Rule 5).
commonFailureModes: Comparison-Printer Syndrome: Printing IC/RMSE tables without outputting actionable drift/anchor/band state policies. Recovery: Map every fault to concrete policy multipliers.
Hardcoded Geopolitical Bullishness (Rule 7 Violation): Mapping geopolitics -> bullish gold during a USD liquidity squeeze. Recovery: Gate news impulse by realized residual and real-yield check.
Candidate Slope Cloning: Magenta line cloning failing live slope during WRONG_DIRECTION fault. Recovery: Enforce structural divergence.
playbooks.nextImprovement: Expand Episodic Shock Bank Mahalanobis recall to include cross-venue basis dispersion velocity during London-NY overlap.

playbooks.playbookName: Real Data Waterfall & Provenance — Multi-Venue PAXG Spot vs. COMEX GC=F Basis & Circuit Breaker
playbooks.trigger: Triggered on every market or macro fetch in src/services/realDataWaterfall.ts (/api/gold-forecast, /api/provider-diagnostics, and multi-timeframe bootstrap).
inputs: Approved Primary Spot Gold Token Cameras (PAXG_SPOT_TOKEN): Binance Vision, Binance Spot, Bybit V5, KuCoin, OKX, HTX, Kraken, Coinbase, Gate.io.
Approved Futures Benchmark Camera (COMEX_GOLD_FUTURES): Yahoo Finance GC=F (strictly separate identity for basis/cointegration).
Approved Macro & Yield Feeds: 10Y TIPS Real Yield, 10Y Nominal Treasury (^TNX), DXY Dollar Index.
steps: Enforce Content-Type & HTML Rejection Guard: Reject HTML block pages or non-JSON responses and log to getProviderHttpDiagnostics().
Validate Bar Count, Sequence Completeness & Staleness (Decision Rule 13): Verify monotonic timestamps, positive OHLCV, and FRESH/STALE/HALT thresholds without synthetic interpolation.
Preserve Strict Instrument Identity Separation (Decision Rule 11): Keep PAXG_SPOT_TOKEN and COMEX_GOLD_FUTURES separate; never launder GC=F as PAXG spot.
Evaluate Cross-Venue Quorum & Dispersion: Compute cross-venue dispersion (bps) and quorum ratio across responding spot cameras.
Engage Circuit Breaker on Total Failure (Decision Rule 2): Transition to HALTED_DEGRADED with zero synthetic candles if all verified spot cameras fail.
outputs: VerifiedWaterfallResult with candles, secondaryBenchmark, verifiedVenueCameras, systemState, activeProvider, freshnessAgeSec, and diagnostics.
proofRequired: Automated verification via scripts/check-phase0-baseline-integrity.ts and /api/provider-diagnostics confirming isSynthetic === false, HTML rejection guard, and HALTED_DEGRADED circuit breaker.
commonFailureModes: Silent Symbol Substitution (Rule 11 Violation): Substituting GC=F futures for PAXG spot and injecting a $15-$40 basis jump. Recovery: Keep GC=F strictly in secondaryBenchmark.
HTML Error Page Crash: Upstream returning HTTP 200 with Cloudflare HTML. Recovery: Pre-parse Content-Type and JSON guard.
Fabricated Macro Lift on Outage: Inventing default real-yield values when macro feed fails. Recovery: Mark MACRO_FEED_UNAVAILABLE and netMacroLift = 0.
playbooks.nextImprovement: Add per-venue rolling latency percentile tracking (p50/p95 ms) to prioritize the fastest healthy quorum camera.

playbooks.playbookName: Real-Time News Context Path — Approved RSS Ingestion, UNAVAILABLE Fallback & Transmission Mismatch
playbooks.trigger: Triggered whenever fetchVerifiedMacroNews in src/services/realDataWaterfall.ts ingests live RSS feeds or when intelligenceAwarenessCore.ts evaluates news-to-price transmission.
inputs: Approved live RSS sources only: Yahoo Finance Gold/Macro RSS, CNBC Economy & Fed RSS, MarketWatch Top Stories RSS.
Verified timestamps, titles, summaries, and provenance.
Realized PAXG spot returns, innovation residuals z_t, and macro yield/DXY changes.
steps: Fetch Approved Live RSS Feeds with Strict Timeout & Cache TTL: Track activeSources and failedSources.
Enforce Zero-Fabrication Fallback (Decision Rule 14): If all news sources fail, return status = UNAVAILABLE and events = [] with explicit bilingual unavailable message.
Assign First-Pass Category Tags: Classify into monetary, inflation, yields, central_bank, geopolitics.
Verify Market Transmission Alignment (Decision Rule 7): Compare news tag vs realized price/residual; flag NEWS_TRANSMISSION_MISMATCH if safe-haven tag conflicts with liquidation.
outputs: VerifiedMacroNewsFeed (LIVE_NEWS_OK | DEGRADED | UNAVAILABLE, activeSources, failedSources, events with provenance).
proofRequired: Verification via simulated news failure (?simulateFailure=news) confirming status === UNAVAILABLE and events.length === 0 with zero fabricated headlines.
commonFailureModes: Hallucinated Fallback Headlines (Rule 14 Violation): Inventing static headlines when RSS fails. Recovery: Return empty events array and UNAVAILABLE status.

Slogan-Driven Plume Overwrite (Rule 7 Violation): Shifting Yellow Line plume by keyword sentiment without market/residual support. Recovery: Restrict news to context and candidate hypothesis exploration.
playbooks.nextImprovement: Expose RSS cache age in seconds (cacheAgeSec) in Operator Diagnostics when serving cached last-good headlines.

playbooks.playbookName: Parallel Universe & Promotion Gates — Candidate Lab Isolation, OOS Scoreboard Honesty & Dual-Control Promotion
playbooks.trigger: Triggered whenever Parallel Universe synthesizes/evaluates a candidate architecture (Magenta Line), during the 8-Step Scientific Discovery Cycle, or on candidate promotion / latent math write-back requests.
inputs: Live Architecture state (Yellow Line) and Candidate Architecture state (Magenta Line) from intelligenceAwarenessCore.ts.
Walk-forward OOS residual history and 8-Gate Verification Scorecard.
GDF Operating System Proof Registry verifying stage-gate compliance.
steps: Maintain Strict Dual-Line Isolation (Decision Rule 8): Evaluate candidate in shadow state space (Magenta Line) isolated from live production filter (Yellow Line).
Synthesize Causal-Symbolic Candidate Hypothesis: Use Granger + PC causal pruning, symbolic grammar DAGs, and SINDy sparse STLSQ regression.
Enforce 8-Gate Walk-Forward OOS Verification: Compare Live vs Candidate on OOS realized bars; mark CALIBRATING if sample size is insufficient.

Enforce Dual-Control Promotion Gate (Rule 8 + GDF OS Proof Gate): Require OOS gates + verified GDF OS Proof for AUTOMATIC_VERIFIED promotion; log explicit operator audit note for MANUAL_MMI and preserve 1-click rollback.
Execute Post-Integration Monitoring: Run runMonitorStage after promotion/write-back and auto-rollback if OOS residuals degrade.
outputs: PromotionGateEvaluation with per-gate PASS/FAIL/CALIBRATING status and audit log.
proofRequired: Automated verification via scripts/check-parallel-universe-core.ts and scripts/check-eight-step-scientific-cycle.ts confirming isolation, promotion gating, and rollback.
commonFailureModes: In-Sample Overfitting Promotion: Promoting high-depth polynomial fitting noise. Recovery: Enforce SINDy sparsity and OOS Diebold-Mariano / Rank-IC gates.
Silent Live Overwrite (Rule 8 Violation): Mutating live weights during candidate search. Recovery: Enforce strict candidate/live isolation until gated promotion.
playbooks.nextImprovement: Bind every candidate promotion event to an immutable Proof Report ID in data/gdf_os_registry.json.
